meaning: 完全出乎意料，极度惊讶
usageNote: 形容词短语！被事情搞得目瞪口呆时用，比just surprised强多了，语气超夸张！

examples.en: I was completely surprised when they threw me a birthday party.
examples.zh: 他们给我办生日派对，我完全没料到！

examples.en: She was completely surprised by the job offer from her dream company.
examples.zh: 收到梦想公司的录用通知，她惊讶得不敢相信。
